mapper.select: SELECT r.`id` AS roomId, r.`name` AS roomName, COUNT(res.`id`) AS bookingCount, COALESCE(SUM(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, res.`start_time`, res.`end_time`)), 0) AS occupiedMinutes FROM `meeting_room` r LEFT JOIN `reservation` res ON r.`id` = res.`room_id` AND res.`reserve_date` = #{date} AND res.`status` != 'CANCELLED' WHERE r.`deleted_at` IS NULL GROUP BY r.`id`, r.`name` ORDER BY bookingCount DESC, occupiedMinutes DESC, r.`id` ASC

SELECT r.`id` AS roomId, r.`name` AS roomName, COUNT(res.`id`) AS bookingCount, COALESCE(SUM(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, res.`start_time`, res.`end_time`)), 0) AS occupiedMinutes FROM `meeting_room` r LEFT JOIN `reservation` res ON r.`id` = res.`room_id` AND res.`reserve_date` >= #{startDate} AND res.`reserve_date` <= #{endDate} AND res.`status` != 'CANCELLED' WHERE r.`deleted_at` IS NULL GROUP BY r.`id`, r.`name` ORDER BY bookingCount DESC, occupiedMinutes DESC, r.`id` ASC

SELECT d.`id` AS deptId, d.`name` AS deptName, COUNT(res.`id`) AS bookingCount, COALESCE(SUM(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, res.`start_time`, res.`end_time`)), 0) AS occupiedMinutes FROM `department` d LEFT JOIN `reservation` res ON d.`id` = res.`dept_id` AND res.`reserve_date` = #{date} AND res.`status` != 'CANCELLED' WHERE d.`deleted_at` IS NULL GROUP BY d.`id`, d.`name` ORDER BY bookingCount DESC, occupiedMinutes DESC, d.`id` ASC
